nl_request: Find the procurement requests with a request date on or after 2024-02-20 and before 2025-05-11, for an amount of at least 5000, from vendors with a risk rating of at least 3, requested by an employee in the Legal or Facilities department, with no need-by date recorded, and requested by an employee whose procurement requests with a request date in that same window add up to at least 15000 in total (counting all of that employee's requests in the window, whatever their vendor, need-by date or status). Return the IDs of the matching procurement requests.
reference_sql:
SELECT pr.id
FROM procurement_requests AS pr
JOIN vendors AS v ON v.id = pr.vendor_id
JOIN employees AS e ON e.id = pr.requested_by_employee_id
JOIN departments AS d ON d.id = e.department_id
WHERE pr.requested_at >= '2024-02-20'
  AND pr.requested_at < '2025-05-11'
  AND pr.amount >= 5000
  AND v.risk_rating >= 3
  AND d.name IN ('Legal', 'Facilities')
  AND pr.needed_by IS NULL
  AND (
    SELECT SUM(other.amount) FROM procurement_requests AS other
    WHERE other.requested_by_employee_id = pr.requested_by_employee_id
      AND other.requested_at >= '2024-02-20' AND other.requested_at < '2025-05-11'
  ) >= 15000
ORDER BY pr.id
